subtitle: How a Captive Captain Forged Travancore’s Wall of Fire

panels.shot: low-angle wide of a weathered European officer on a stone rampart, cannons and dense Kerala hills behind him, distant lines of drilling soldiers below
panels.action: Eustachius De Lannoy stands in Travancore armour atop Udayagiri’s ramparts, one hand resting on a cannon, watching long files of Nair soldiers drilling in formation across a misty valley.

dialogue.text: Captured at Colachel, the Dutchman Eustachius De Lannoy rose to command fifty thousand in Travancore—how did a defeated foreigner become the engineer of its forts, guns and great defensive lines?

i18n.hi: कोलाचेल में बंदी बना डच अधिकारी यूस्ताकियस डी लैनोई, त्रावणकोर में पचास हज़ार का सेनापति बना – हारा हुआ परदेसी किले, तोपें और रक्षा रेखाएँ कैसे रच गया?

panels.shot: medium close-up from behind De Lannoy in chains, looking out over the Colachel shoreline with burning ships and Marthanda Varma’s camp in the distance
panels.action: A younger De Lannoy, hands bound with rope, stands on the sandy shore of Colachel as captured Dutch masts list in the waves and Travancore tents rise beyond.

dialogue.text: Colachel, 1741. The Dutch defeat is complete. Among the prisoners, a quiet officer named Eustachius De Lannoy waits, unsure if his new life will begin—or end—on this shore.

i18n.hi: कोलाचेल, 1741. डचों की हार पूरी. कैदियों में एक शांत अफ़सर यूस्ताकियस डी लैनोई बैठा है, नहीं जानता – नई ज़िंदगी शुरू होगी या यहीं ख़त्म।

panels.shot: slow push-in on De Lannoy’s face in three-quarter profile as he stands before an unseen ruler, torchlight flickering
panels.action: Inside a palm-thatched pavilion, De Lannoy stands guarded, chin raised yet wary, lit by oil lamps as a shadowed royal figure sits higher, unseen to the reader.

dialogue.text: Travancore’s ruler, Marthanda Varma, has beaten the Company’s men with Nair courage and a tightening fiscal state. Now he studies their defeated captain and sees something useful in his calm eyes.

i18n.hi: त्रावणकोर का राजा मार्तंड वर्मा ने कंपनी के सिपाहियों को नायर वीरता और सख़्त खज़ाने से हराया है. अब वह हारे हुए कप्तान को देखता है, उसकी शांत आँखों में काम की चीज़ खोजता है.

panels.shot: medium two-shot over the ruler’s shoulder toward De Lannoy, emphasizing body language
panels.action: De Lannoy bows slightly, one hand to his chest, as he appears to accept terms from the unseen throne, guards around him relaxing just enough to show the change.

dialogue.text: The king offers a choice recorded by Travancore chroniclers—service instead of death. De Lannoy accepts, stepping from prisoner to hired skill, into an army already sharpening itself for a new age.

i18n.hi: राजा उसे वही विकल्प देता है जिसे त्रावणकोर के इतिहासकार लिखते हैं – मौत की जगह सेवा. डी लैनोई मान जाता है, कैदी से क़रार पर बुलाए गए उस्ताद की तरह, उस फ़ौज में कूद पड़ता है जो नए दौर के लिए खुद को धार दे रही है.

panels.shot: wide shot of a drill ground, with De Lannoy foreground and ranks of Nair soldiers midground
panels.action: On a dusty field near Padmanabhapuram, De Lannoy strides along rows of barefoot Nair infantry, musket on shoulder, as they practice synchronized volleys under his watch.

dialogue.text: He is made Valiya Kappittan, the Great Captain. The Nair militia is hard and loyal, but now it must learn European drill, musket volleys and the discipline of a standing army.

i18n.hi: उसे बनाया जाता है वलिय कपिट्टान – महान कप्तान. नायर मिलिशिया सख़्त और वफ़ादार है, पर अब उसे यूरोपीय क़दमताल, बंदूकों की बारिश और स्थायी फ़ौज वाला अनुशासन सीखना है.

panels.shot: medium shot side-on, showing De Lannoy correcting a soldier’s stance while smoke from a recent volley hangs in the air
panels.action: De Lannoy gently but firmly adjusts a young Nair’s musket grip while other soldiers, faces streaked with sweat, stand ready in straight lines behind him in a haze of spent powder.

dialogue.speaker: eustachius_de_lannoy
dialogue.text: Together, step, aim, fire. Your strength lies in moving as one.

i18n.hi: मिलकर – क़दम, निशाना, आग. तुम्हारी ताक़त है, एक साथ चलना.

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of a large encampment with ordered rows of tents and training spaces
panels.action: A sprawling Travancore camp stretches between coconut groves: separate squares for infantry, cavalry horses tethered under trees, and a fenced artillery park where cannons are being cleaned.

dialogue.text: By the mid-eighteenth century, Travancore’s forces swell to tens of thousands. Nair infantry, recruited horsemen and European-drilled artillery form the backbone of a force paid from a reorganised land revenue.

i18n.hi: अठारहवीं सदी के बीच तक त्रावणकोर की सेना दसियों हज़ार तक फूल जाती है. नायर पैदल, भर्ती घुड़सवार और यूरोपीय ढंग से सिखाई तोपें – ये सब मिलकर ज़मीन-राजस्व से पाली रीढ़ बनते हैं.

panels.shot: low-angle medium shot of De Lannoy beside a cannon, instructing gunners
panels.action: Within Udayagiri Fort’s stone walls, De Lannoy stands by a heavy cannon as gunners in simple cotton uniforms listen, ramrods and shot laid neatly in a row.

dialogue.text: At forts like Udayagiri, he improves artillery. State records remember his care in training gunners, placing pieces to command passes and coasts, turning old walls into living engines of defence.

i18n.hi: उदयगिरि जैसे किलों में वह तोपख़ाना दुरुस्त करता है. सरकारी रेकॉर्ड उसके तोपचियों की सख़्त ट्रेनिंग, दर्रे और तट पर तोपों की जुगत, और पुरानी दीवारों को ज़िंदा रक्षा मशीन बनाने को याद रखते हैं.

panels.shot: sweeping wide shot of Udayagiri Fort against the hills, showing bastions and terrain
panels.action: The camera takes in Udayagiri Fort’s massive laterite ramparts, bastions jutting out over a green valley, with De Lannoy a small but distinct figure walking the parapet, surveying fields and distant villages.

dialogue.text: Udayagiri, near Padmanabhapuram, becomes his base. Travancore manuals will later note its strengthened walls and guns, part of a network of forts anchoring the kingdom’s expanding frontiers.

i18n.hi: पद्मनाभपुरम के पास उदयगिरि उसका गढ़ बन जाता है. बाद के त्रावणकोर मैनुअल इसकी मज़बूत दीवारों और तोपों का ज़िक्र करेंगे – किलों के उस जाल का हिस्सा जो बढ़ती सीमा को जकड़ता है.

panels.shot: medium interior shot of a simple map room, lit by daylight, with De Lannoy and a local officer over a map
panels.action: In a whitewashed room, De Lannoy leans over a hand-drawn map with a bearded Nair officer, tracing lines with his finger while palm-frond roofs and trees are visible beyond the open window.

dialogue.text: Yet he does not work alone. Indigenous captains, accountants and engineers bring knowledge of land and levies; De Lannoy brings methods of drill and fortification. Together they align men, money and walls.

i18n.hi: पर वह अकेला काम नहीं करता. देसी कप्तान, मुनशी और इंजीनियर ज़मीन और लगान की समझ लाते हैं; डी लैनोई क़दमताल और क़िला-साज़ी का तरीका. साथ मिलकर वे सिपाही, रुपया और दीवारें सीधी पंक्ति में खड़ी करते हैं.

panels.shot: wide shot of a coastal scene with watchtowers and small vessels, hinting at naval concerns
panels.action: Along a windy shore, wooden watchtowers overlook fishing craft and small armed boats rocking in the surf, with De Lannoy conferring with local commanders as they point to the sea.

dialogue.text: Beyond land, the sea is restless. Dutch, English and local fleets contest pepper and routes. Historians of naval resistance note Travancore among those who refused easy submission to rising ocean empires.

i18n.hi: ज़मीन के पार समंदर उफ़नता है. डच, अंग्रेज़ और देसी बेड़े काली मिर्च और रास्तों पर भिड़ते हैं. समुंदर-रोध की कहानियाँ त्रावणकोर को उन राजों में गिनती हैं जो उभरती समुद्री सल्तनतों के आगे सहसा नहीं झुके.

panels.shot: medium shot of De Lannoy supervising carpenters and labourers marking lines across a forest clearing
panels.action: In a forested plain north of Travancore, De Lannoy, now older, stands with surveyors and carpenters as they mark a straight line through trees, labourers clearing brush in ordered rows.

dialogue.text: Under Dharma Raja, Marthanda Varma’s successor, a new project begins—the Nedumkotta. De Lannoy is placed over its works, tasked to help turn forests and fields into a continuous barrier.

i18n.hi: धर्मराजा, यानी मार्तंड वर्मा के उत्तराधिकारी के दौर में नया काम शुरू होता है – नेदमकोट्टा. इसके काम पर डी लैनोई को बिठाया जाता है – जंगल और खेतों को लगातार दीवार में बदलने का हुक्म देकर.

panels.shot: high-angle wide over the beginning of the Nedumkotta line, showing ditch, rampart and workers
panels.action: A freshly dug trench runs across the landscape; behind it rises an earthen rampart where workers tamp the soil, while others plant bamboo saplings along the crest under De Lannoy’s distant gaze.

dialogue.text: Travancore’s State Manual later describes it plainly—a ditch in front, a raised embankment behind, a hedge of bamboo above, with bastions and gun positions placed at intervals along the line.

i18n.hi: त्रावणकोर स्टेट मैनुअल इसे सीधी ज़ुबान में दर्ज करता है – आगे खाई, पीछे उठा बाँध, ऊपर बाँस की झाड़ी, और बीच-बीच में बुर्ज और तोपों की चौकियाँ.

panels.shot: medium shot of De Lannoy examining a cross-section of the ditch and embankment, pointing out adjustments
panels.action: Standing in the shade, De Lannoy watches men measure the depth of the ditch and height of the bank, his hand raised as he directs slight changes to slope and width.

dialogue.text: The Nedumkotta is no mythical Great Wall, but for Kerala it is vast—a regional engineering work meant to slow northern armies and give Travancore’s guns and infantry the ground they need.

i18n.hi: नेदमकोट्टा कोई काल्पनिक महान दीवार नहीं, पर केरल के लिए विशाल है – ऐसा इलाकाई इंजीनियरिंग काम जो उत्तरी फ़ौजों की रफ़्तार तोड़े और त्रावणकोर की तोप-पैदल को ज़मीन दे.

panels.shot: dynamic wide shot of soldiers manning a bastion on the Nedumkotta during a drill
panels.action: On a finished section of the Nedumkotta, Nair soldiers stand atop a bastion, muskets ready as a small cannon peers over the bamboo hedge; De Lannoy watches from the rampart’s rear as they drill.

dialogue.text: Bastions crown the embankment. Cannon point through cleared openings. Behind the hedge, fifty thousand drilled men can move along the line, ready to muster where danger presses hardest.

i18n.hi: बुर्ज बाँध के ऊपर ताज की तरह बैठे हैं. साफ़ की गई झिरकियों से तोपें झाँकती हैं. बाँस के पीछे पचास हज़ार सधे सिपाही लाइन के साथ दौड़ सकते हैं, तैयार हैं वहीं जमने को जहां ख़तरा सबसे ज़्यादा धकियाए.

panels.shot: close-up on De Lannoy’s lined face as he looks out over the Nedumkotta, evening light soft
panels.action: With the sun low, De Lannoy stands on the rampart, his face older and lined, eyes following the curve of the fortification as it snakes toward the horizon.

dialogue.speaker: eustachius_de_lannoy
dialogue.text: From Colachel’s chains to these walls… war writes strange paths.

i18n.hi: कोलाचेल की ज़ंजीरों से इन दीवारों तक… जंग अजीब राहें लिखती है.

panels.shot: somber medium shot in a Travancore churchyard, with De Lannoy’s tomb and distant fort
panels.action: In a quiet churchyard near Udayagiri, a stone tomb bearing a carved European figure lies under a tree, with the outline of the fort’s ramparts visible beyond the branches.

dialogue.text: He dies in Travancore, buried near the fort he made his home. Chronicles remember him as Valiya Kappittan, yet always within the larger story of a kingdom’s taxes, roads, temples and treaties.

i18n.hi: वह त्रावणकोर में ही मरता है, उसी किले के पास दफ़्न, जिसे अपना घर बना लिया था. इतिहास उसे वलिय कपिट्टान कहकर याद करता है – पर हमेशा उस बड़े किस्से के भीतर, जिसमें राज्य के टैक्स, सड़कें, मंदिर और सन्धियाँ हैं.

panels.shot: final wide, slightly elevated shot of the Nedumkotta line dissolving into today’s landscape, with a faint ghosted image of drilling soldiers over it
panels.action: The old embankment, overgrown with grass and trees, winds through modern fields, while faint ghostly ranks of eighteenth-century soldiers and De Lannoy’s silhouette seem to march along it.

dialogue.text: The Nedumkotta will one day face Mysore’s storm, its ramparts tested by new wars. But its making shows a quiet truth—that even in defeat and captivity, knowledge can shape a kingdom’s survival.

i18n.hi: नेदमकोट्टा को एक दिन मैसूर के तूफ़ान का सामना करना होगा, उसकी दीवारें नई जंगों में आज़माई जाएँगी. पर उसका बनना एक धीमी सच्चाई दिखाता है – कि हार और क़ैद में भी ज्ञान एक राज्य की जान बचा सकता है.

title_i18n.en: Fifty Thousand Soldiers and a Dutch General
title_i18n.hi: पचास हज़ार सिपाही और एक डच जनरल

subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे एक बंदी कप्तान ने त्रावणकोर की आग की दीवार गढ़ी
